verdict.rationale: Claude's Managed Agents docs include a first-party "Subscribe to webhooks" page with supported session event types and registrable endpoints. That makes this a direct, documented capability. However, it is beta-gated behind the managed-agents-2026-04-01 header and limited to Managed Agents sessions, not the wider Claude product. Claude Code hooks are local shell commands, not outbound HTTP webhooks, so they earn no credit here. Missing for 10: general-availability (non-beta) status, webhook coverage beyond Managed Agents sessions, independent or hands-on corroboration of delivery and reliability.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can subscribe to events via webhooks

citations.quote: Although most real-time interactions occur through the SSE event stream, webhooks notify you of major state changes.
It lists supported session event types and registrable endpoints. The surface is in beta, gated by the managed-agents-2026-04-01 beta header, and is scoped to Managed Agents sessions.
